steps.title: Align reads with BWA and process with Samtools
steps.instruction: Align the cleaned paired‑end FASTQ files to the hg19 reference using BWA, convert the alignment to SAM, then to BAM, sort, generate flagstat and index the sorted BAM.

substeps.instruction: Run BWA aln for read 1: `bwa aln -t 30 $DATABASES_PATH/hg19_fa-chrMlast/hg19_chrM-last.fa $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_cleaned_R1.fastq > $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_R1.sai` (BWA v0.5.9).
Run BWA aln for read 2: `bwa aln -t 30 $DATABASES_PATH/hg19_fa-chrMlast/hg19_chrM-last.fa $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_cleaned_R2.fastq > $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_R2.sai`.

Generate paired‑end SAM with BWA sampe: `bwa sampe $DATABASES_PATH/hg19_fa-chrMlast/hg19_chrM-last.fa $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_R1.sai $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_R2.sai $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_cleaned_R1.fastq $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_cleaned_R2.fastq > $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}.sam`.

steps.title: Add read groups and remove PCR duplicates with Picard
steps.instruction: Add read‑group information to the sorted BAM, then mark (and remove) PCR duplicates, finally index the deduplicated BAM.

substeps.instruction: Add read groups (Picard 2.0.1, 50 GB Java heap): `java -Djava.io.tmpdir=$TEMP_DIR/ -Xmx50g -jar $SOFTWARE_PATH/picard/build/libs/picard.jar AddOrReplaceReadGroups I="$SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_sorted.bam" O="$SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_coordsort.bam" ID="1" LB="libraryname" PL="Illumina" PU="platform unit" SM=${SAMPLE_NAME} SO=coordinate VALIDATION_STRINGENCY=SILENT`.

Mark (and remove) duplicates: `java -Djava.io.tmpdir=$TEMP_DIR/ -Xmx50g -jar $SOFTWARE_PATH/picard/build/libs/picard.jar MarkDuplicates I="$SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_coordsort.bam" O="$SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_RMDUP.bam" M="metrics" REMOVE_DUPLICATES=true ASSUME_SORTED=true VALIDATION_STRINGENCY=LENIENT`.

steps.title: Call variants with Isaac and filter VCFs
steps.instruction: Run the Isaac variant caller, extract PASS variants, separate SNPs and indels, and prepare compressed VCF files for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Configure and run Isaac (Isaac 1.0.7, rtg‑tools 3.7.1): ` $SOFTWARE_PATH/isaac_variant_caller-master/bin/configureWorkflow.pl --bam=$SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/${SAMPLE_NAME}_RMDUP.bam --ref=$DATABASES_PATH/hg19_fa-chrMlast/hg19_chrM-last.fa --config=$SAMPLE_PATH/config.ini --output-dir=$SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/cd` then ` $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/make -j 16`.

steps.title: Assess alignment quality with Qualimap
steps.instruction: Run Qualimap bamqc on the deduplicated BAM using the TruSeq1 BED file and generate a PDF report.

steps.title: Generate VCF statistics with rtg‑tools
steps.instruction: Compute VCF statistics for SNP and indel VCFs and store them in the VCF_QC subdirectory.

substeps.instruction: Run vcfstats on SNP VCF: ` $SOFTWARE_PATH/rtg-tools-3.7.1/rtg vcfstats $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/${SAMPLE_NAME}_snp.vcf > $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/VCF_QC/${SAMPLE_NAME}_snp.vcf.stat`.

Run vcfstats on indel VCF: ` $SOFTWARE_PATH/rtg-tools-3.7.1/rtg vcfstats $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/${SAMPLE_NAME}_indel.vcf > $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/VCF_QC/${SAMPLE_NAME}_indel.vcf.stat`

steps.title: Annotate variants with ANNOVAR
steps.instruction: Convert SNP and indel VCFs to ANNOVAR input format and run table_annovar with the hg19 database and a comprehensive annotation protocol list.

substeps.instruction: Convert SNP VCF to avinput: `perl $SOFTWARE_PATH/annovar/convert2annovar.pl -format vcf4 $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/${SAMPLE_NAME}_snp.vcf > $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/annotated_annovar/${SAMPLE_NAME}_snp.vcf.avinput`.

Convert indel VCF to avinput: `perl $SOFTWARE_PATH/annovar/convert2annovar.pl -format vcf4 $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/${SAMPLE_NAME}_indel.vcf > $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_13_VARIANT_CALLING/annotated_annovar/${SAMPLE_NAME}_indel.vcf.avinput`.

steps.title: Extract mitochondrial reads and index
steps.instruction: Create a BAM containing only chrM reads from the deduplicated BAM and index it.

steps.title: Predict blood group phenotypes with BOOGIE
steps.instruction: Prepare the BOOGIE scripts, set executable permissions, and run the blood‑group detection pipeline.

substeps.instruction: Rename BOOGIE helper scripts (example for each script): `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_phase2_blood_group_detection.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_phase2_blood_group_summary.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_phase2_blood_group_genes_extracter.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`.

steps.title: Generate virtual SNP reports
steps.instruction: Run a series of rename scripts, set permissions, and execute exonic‑extract Perl scripts to produce virtual SNP files.

substeps.instruction: Rename a set of rsID and exonic scripts (examples): `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_phase2_1rsid_get.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_phase2_2rsid_filter.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_phase2_3rsid_venn.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_phase2_4rsid_venn.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_extract_common_indel.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_extract_common_snp.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_extract_rsid_indel.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_extract_rsid_snp.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_extract_unique_Illimina_snp.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_extract_unique_indel_Illimina.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_extract_unique_indel_sample.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_extract_unique_sample_snp.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`; `perl $SAMPLE_PATH/rename_exonic_venn_snp_indel.pl $SAMPLE_NAME`.

steps.title: Analyze structural variants with GASV
steps.instruction: Prepare GASV scripts, run the GASV pipeline, and move resulting files to the report directory.

steps.title: Extract gene integration junctions with samtools grep
steps.instruction: For each target gene (cmyc, bmi, bclxl, KLF4, Lin28, oct, sox2) extract forward and reverse junction sequences from the deduplicated BAM using samtools view and grep, storing results in the GENE_INTEGRATION report directory.

steps.title: Detect Mycoplasma contamination with BWA
steps.instruction: Align cleaned reads to the Mycoplasma alai‑lawii reference, convert to BAM, sort, generate flagstat, index, obtain idxstats, and count reads with mapping quality ≥20.

substeps.instruction: Count high‑quality reads for each BAM in the Mycoplasma report directory:

```bash
for BAM in $SAMPLE_PATH/$SAMPLE_NAME/Report_${SAMPLE_NAME}_18_Mycoplasma/*bam ; do
  CNT=`samtools view -c -q20 $BAM`
  echo $BAM $CNT
done
```
